topic: Function Pointer Arrays for Dynamic Dispatch
explanation: In advanced C programming, function pointer arrays enable dynamic selection and invocation of functions at runtime, facilitating flexible callback mechanisms, plugin architectures, or state machines. This technique leverages function pointers stored in arrays to implement polymorphic behavior, optimize performance, or manage complex control flows without resorting to cumbersome switch statements or multiple conditional branches.
